newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: INL won't set cash issue to fund TV stake.
newsitem.headline: INL won't set cash issue to fund TV stake.

text.p: Independent Newspapers Ltd said on Friday it would fund its planned purchase of a substantial stake in New Zealand's Sky Network TV from current facilities and would not need a cash issue.

Chief executive Mike Robson told reporters if talks to buy into Sky were successful, the company would have no need to raise equity from shareholders and would fund the purchase from current debt facilities.
"We would have no need to go to shareholders. Obviously we would have to fund the purchase by debt," he said.
Robson said INL had been in substantive discussions for some time and was hoping to resolve talks in "reasonably quick time".
He added he expected the talks to be completed by Christmas.
Robson said INL was not looking to buy the whole of Sky.
